login-intro: Describe a page, watch it being made, change it, publish it.
new-project-hint: What do you want to make?
prompt-first: Describe what you want to make
still-working: Still working on the last request.
made-private: The owner made this project private.
connecting: Connecting… try again in a moment.
usage-energy-note: Energy is measured only for work done in the pool, on the whole computer that did it.
board-empty: Nothing here yet. Double-click or double-tap to add text.
upscale-intro: Make a picture four times larger, on a computer in the pool or on Cloudflare. Only the model and the time are recorded, and the energy for work done in the pool, never the picture.
upscale-shrunk: It was made smaller first, to {w} × {h}.
upscale-done-paid: {w} × {h}, done in {s} s by {model} on Cloudflare, a paid service.
upscale-none: No computer in the pool can upscale right now.
estonia-about: Run on {date}. The judge can't count or check spelling, so look at the pictures too.
visuals-intro-estonia: Picture models each drew the same ten Estonian things. Most ran on Cloudflare’s computers, paid per picture. Older ones ran on our own Macs: DALL·E mini (2022) in a browser tab, Stable Diffusion models on the M1. For every picture, a judge model (Clef-flash) answered questions such as “Is the top stripe of the flag blue?”. A model’s score is the share of questions answered yes. Click a picture to see its answers.
visuals-intro-germany: Picture models each drew the same ten German things. Most ran on Cloudflare’s computers, paid per picture. Older ones ran on our own Macs: DALL·E mini (2022) in a browser tab, Stable Diffusion models on the M1. For every picture, a judge model (Clef-flash) answered questions such as “Is the top stripe of the flag black?”. A model’s score is the share of questions answered yes. Click a picture to see its answers.
visuals-not-run: This country hasn’t been run yet.
visuals-title-design: How well models know design classics
visuals-intro-design: Picture models each drew the same ten graphic design movements and methods, as posters. Most ran on Cloudflare’s computers, paid per picture. DALL·E mini (2022) ran in a browser tab on a Mac. For every picture, a judge model (Clef-flash) answered questions about what it can see, such as “Are there only horizontal and vertical black lines?”. A model’s score is the share of questions answered yes. Click a picture to see its answers.
upscale-for-fast: Makes the picture four times larger.
upscale-for-detailed: Four times larger, with more detail, slower.
upscale-for-klein: Redraws the picture larger and invents detail. It follows the instruction below, which you can change.
upscale-no-instruction: This upscaler takes only the picture, no instruction. Pick a FLUX.2 klein model to write one.
upscale-for-klein4: Redraws the picture larger, like klein 9B but cheaper. It follows the instruction below.
draw-intro: Your words go to each model you tick exactly as you type them. Most run on Cloudflare, paid per picture. ChilloutMix runs on a computer in the pool and is also told to avoid nudity. Only the model, time and cost are recorded, and the energy for work done in the pool, never your words or the picture.
draw-for-flux-2-klein-4b: Black Forest Labs, 2026. The studio’s own picture model.
draw-for-flux-2-klein-9b: Black Forest Labs, 2026. Larger and sharper, often the fastest.
draw-for-flux-2-dev: Black Forest Labs. The best at text and detail in our tests, slower.
draw-for-phoenix-1.0: Leonardo. Its maker’s own model, run on Cloudflare.
draw-for-lucid-origin: Leonardo. Its maker’s own model, run on Cloudflare.
draw-for-flux-2-pro-preview: Black Forest Labs. Run by its maker, through Cloudflare.
draw-for-qwen-image-3.0-pro: Alibaba. Run by its maker, through Cloudflare. Made for layouts and small text.
draw-for-seedream-5-pro: ByteDance. Run by its maker, through Cloudflare.
draw-for-grok-imagine-image-quality: xAI. Run by its maker, through Cloudflare. Made for sharp detail and text.
draw-for-gpt-image-2: OpenAI. Run by its maker, through Cloudflare.
draw-for-nano-banana-pro: Google. Run by its maker, through Cloudflare.
draw-for-sdxl: Stability AI, 2023. Leaves Cloudflare on 20 November 2026.
draw-for-sdxl-lightning: ByteDance, 2024. Fast, rough. Leaves Cloudflare on 20 November 2026.
draw-for-dreamshaper-8-lcm: Lykon, 2023. Made for 512 px, so larger sizes come out smeared. Leaves Cloudflare on 20 November 2026.
draw-none-pool: No computer in the pool can draw this right now.
draw-for-pool/chilloutmix: A community fine-tune of Stable Diffusion 1.5, 2023. Drawn by a computer in the pool.
prompts-intro: When the studio or the pool asks a model for work, it adds words of its own to yours. These are all of them, and when each one is sent.
prompts-teacher: You can change them for your school. A change counts from the next request.
prompts-student: Only the teacher can change them.
prompts-error-too-long: it is too long, at most {max} characters.
prompts-error-choices: keep one line per choice, each starting with its word and a colon, as in the course default.
prompt-when-page-system: Sent first, with every request in a project.
prompt-name-page-instructions: Making a page: the course instructions
prompt-when-page-instructions: Sent after the rules, with every request in a project.
prompt-when-page-context: Your request, with the earlier requests, the project's files and its home page. Put together each time, so it can't be changed here.
prompt-when-page-path: Tells the model how to name a file when it writes one.
prompt-name-page-cut-off: Making a page: a file cut off
prompt-when-page-cut-off: Sent back to the model when its answer stopped in the middle of a file.
prompt-name-page-undone: Making a page: an edit undone
prompt-when-page-undone: Sent back to the backup model, used when the main one is busy, when its edit removed parts of a file nobody asked to change. {harm} becomes what was removed.
prompt-name-check-state: Checking a page: what the checker sees
prompt-when-check-state: The requests, a phone screenshot of the page and its HTML. Put together each time, so it can't be changed here.
prompt-when-check-fit: Asked after every new version. The answer becomes the “matches the request” percentage.
prompt-name-check-off: Checking a page: what is off
prompt-when-check-off: Asked with the question above. The answer is one of the choices below, kept with the version and not shown.
prompt-when-check-choices: One line each. The word before the colon stays the same.
prompt-when-fix: Sent with a list of the errors when a new version shows errors (twice in a row at most), or when someone clicks Fix them.
prompt-when-upscale-klein: The instruction the Upscale page starts with. Anyone can change their own copy there before upscaling.
prompt-name-pool-negative-chilloutmix: ChilloutMix: what to steer away from
prompt-when-pool-negative-chilloutmix: Sent with every ChilloutMix picture, to steer it away from these things. It does not stop them. One line, at most 200 characters. Computers in the pool with an app older than 0.5.0 use the course default.
prompt-name-pool-json: Pool: answers in a set format
prompt-when-pool-json: Added by the computer in the pool doing the work, when the work needs an answer in a set format and its model can't be held to one. Part of the pool app, so it can't be changed here.
cutout-intro: Cut the main subject out of a picture, on a computer in the pool. That computer sees your picture while it works. It is not kept there or in the pool. Only the model, the time and the energy are recorded.
cutout-none: No computer in the pool can remove backgrounds right now.
